name: B10-0233/2025 (S&D) – Prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior, Tsi Conrad
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior and Tsi Conrad
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Cameroon to release five journalists and a filmmaker held in prison. It says press freedom is badly restricted there and that their trials were unfair, with long delays and military courts. It asks Cameroon to protect journalists, let them work without arrest or harassment, and investigate attacks on them. It also asks the European Union's office in Cameroon to keep watching trials and stay in contact with journalists. The Parliament cannot order any of this; it is stating its position and making requests.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is asking Cameroon to free the five men and protect journalists.
- **Who it affects:** Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior, Tsi Conrad, and journalists in Cameroon.
- **What happens next:** The request goes to Cameroon's government and parliament, and to European Union bodies.
